export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

# arc-canteen
[ -f ~/.arc-canteen/env ] && . ~/.arc-canteen/env

# Homebrew
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"

# Rust/Cargo (includes Arcium binaries)
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"

# Solana CLI
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/solana/install/active_release/bin:$PATH"

# Cursor CLI
export PATH="/Applications/Cursor.app/Contents/Resources/app/bin:$PATH"

# Ensure VS Code's 'code' command takes priority over Cursor's
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

# Node.js (nvm)
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"  # This loads nvm
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion"  # This loads nvm bash_completion
[ -n "$NVM_DIR" ] && command -v nvm >/dev/null && nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1
path=(${path:#$HOME/.npm-global/bin})

# pnpm
export PNPM_HOME="/Users/cartel/Library/pnpm"
path=(${path:#$PNPM_HOME})
export PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"
# pnpm end

export NARGO_HOME="/Users/cartel/.nargo"

export PATH="$PATH:$NARGO_HOME/bin"
export PATH="$PATH:/Users/cartel/development/solana/articles/site_puller"
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@15/bin:$PATH"

# Added by Antigravity
export PATH="/Users/cartel/.antigravity/antigravity/bin:$PATH"

# bun completions
[ -s "/Users/cartel/.bun/_bun" ] && source "/Users/cartel/.bun/_bun"

# bun
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

# bun
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

# Added by LM Studio CLI (lms)
export PATH="$PATH:/Users/cartel/.lmstudio/bin"
# End of LM Studio CLI section

# direnv
eval "
_direnv_hook() {
  trap -- '' SIGINT
  eval "$("/opt/homebrew/bin/direnv" export zsh)"
  trap - SIGINT
}
typeset -ag precmd_functions
if (( ! ${precmd_functions[(I)_direnv_hook]} )); then
  precmd_functions=(_direnv_hook $precmd_functions)
fi
typeset -ag chpwd_functions
if (( ! ${chpwd_functions[(I)_direnv_hook]} )); then
  chpwd_functions=(_direnv_hook $chpwd_functions)
fi"
